case.title: ARB’s first team and investor cliff, 16 March 2024

unlock.amount: 1,110,000,000 ARB unlocked for team, future team, advisors and investors (673.5M team side, 438.25M investors), the first cliff after a one-year lock

reporting.label: Lookonchain, 2024-03-18: 11 whales deposited 34M ARB to exchanges after the unlock
Lookonchain, 2024-03-23: 4 more whale wallets (including 0x4c4a…02b4) deposited 11.34M ARB to Binance
Cointelegraph: Arbitrum unlock whales move $58M to exchanges

caveats: A deposit to an exchange is not proof of a sale; trades on Binance are off-chain. The modelled costs on this page assume each deposit was sold on its day, and say so.
No source identifies the beneficiary as a particular team member or investor, or names anyone. We describe only what the contracts and transfers show.
The exchange label comes from Arbiscan via Lookonchain’s screenshot; the transfers themselves were checked against the chain.

This one beneficiary deposited about 9.46M ARB, under 1% of the 1.11B unlock; it did not by itself move the price. The whole market also fell over the same days: BTC moved about −6% in the same window.

model.label: Model estimate (square-root impact, coefficient 1, volatility from the 30 days before the unlock, Binance volume only). Not an observation.
